svg.title: Exactly which B1 sensors go where
svg.desc: Four moving magnets M0 through M3 sit inside the TPU. Five MLX90393 heads S0 through S4 stay on the rigid side spine. Two N0 pressure-film pads T0 and T1 cover the object-facing nail prongs.

g.text: B1 recommended prototype: magnetic soft region + two pressure-film tip pads
Per finger: 5 × MLX90393 heads · 4 × 3 × 1 mm magnets · 2 × N0 nail pads
Side view — sensor boards are beside the finger
Purple heads bond to the rigid spine. Orange magnets move with the green TPU. Dashed lines indicate pairing, not wires.
Source: unchanged released CAD and R1 nail cut pattern. Side projection omits depth; use placement CSV/JSON for full coordinates.
